messages.subject: private outputs
parts:
For orthogonality, do we have a way of constructing outputs, in the same way as reactiveValues constructs local inputs?

I have a vision of auto detecting changes that causes source(local=T) to run again to re-load components without re-loading the whole application.

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: private outputs
parts:
If I understand the question correctly... Similarly to inputs vs. reactiveValues, you can create something similar but you can't actually hook it up to the communication channel with the client. Inputs are implemented using reactiveValues which are set by shinyapp; outputs are implemented using observers that write their results to shinyapp.

All that said, I'm not sure why you would need any more than the regular input and output objects to implement what you're talking about.
